sources.author: Brave and universal
patch_list: Block Quetta bundled extension installation

Blocks bundled extension installation/reinstallation on arm64-v8a APKs (the framework does not enforce ABI restrictions). Does not remove copies already present in existing profiles. Takes effect immediately on clean installs.

sources.label: Privacy patches, APK rebuilding tools, and DNS blocklists for Quetta Browser
sources.author: Quetta Privacy
patch_list: Disable update and push endpoints
Points the component update and push registration hosts at a non-resolvable domain. Component and ad-block list updates stop, and push notifications do not arrive.
Harden network security config
Disables cleartext traffic in base and domain configurations and drops trust in user-installed CAs.
Remove QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES
Drops android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES from the manifest. May degrade installed-app detection.
Strip analytics endpoints
Points usage reporting, crash reporting and telemetry beacon hosts at a non-resolvable domain, so they cannot be uploaded.
Strip analytics endpoints from native libraries
Rewrites analytics and crash reporting hosts in lib*.so, which bytecode patches cannot reach.
Strip update and push endpoints from native libraries
Rewrites update and push hosts in lib*.so, which bytecode patches cannot reach.
Strip vendor endpoints from native libraries
Rewrites Quetta vendor endpoints in lib*.so, which bytecode patches cannot reach.
Strip vendor tracking endpoints
Points the favicon proxy, start page, video sniffing and share link hosts at a non-resolvable domain. Site icons and start page suggestions stop loading.
